# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** Eighteen years old  <sub>[v3 c1 P17](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0017)</sub>
- **Gender:** female
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Di  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v3 c1 P17](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0017)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, black hair, and rosy, dimpled cheeks. She inherits her father's merry expression and her mother's dark features, having a lively snap and color to her look.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Diana is described as good, smart, and a nice girl who loves reading, though her avid reading habits are sometimes discouraged by her mother. She is affectionate, passionate about her secrets and friendships, and prone to feeling nervous or scared in difficult situations.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021)_

## Traits

- Avid reader  <sub>[v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>
- Easily frightened in crises  <sub>[v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021)</sub>

## Abilities

- Making red tissue paper bookmarkers  <sub>[v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029)</sub>

## History

Diana Barry lived with her parents at Orchard Slope in Avonlea. As a child, she met Anne Shirley and swore an oath of lifelong friendship with her, becoming her intimate chum. When her younger sister Minnie May fell severely ill with croup while their parents were away, Diana turned to Anne for help. Though she attended school alongside Anne and shared walks through the Birch Path, she did not join the Queen's class because her parents did not intend to send her to Queen's Academy. Later, she became the treasurer of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. After a courtship with Fred Wright, Diana married him in a ceremony where her father walked her down the aisle, after which the couple drove away to their new home.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c26 P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v3 c29 P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013)_
